mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document_registry( tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, title, source, file_path, file_name, directory, import_source, chunk_count, deleted_count, embedding_mode, embedding_model, vector_store_mode, import_batch_id, metadata_json, imported_at, updated_at, deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{title}, #{source}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{directory}, #{importSource}, #{chunkCount}, #{deletedCount}, #{embeddingMode}, #{embeddingModel}, #{vectorStoreMode}, #{importBatchId}, #{metadataJson}, #{importedAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0, NULL, NULL, #{importedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), source = VALUES(source), file_path = VALUES(file_path), file_name = VALUES(file_name), directory = VALUES(directory), import_source = VALUES(import_source), chunk_count = VALUES(chunk_count), deleted_count = VALUES(deleted_count), embedding_mode = VALUES(embedding_mode), embedding_model = VALUES(embedding_model), vector_store_mode = VALUES(vector_store_mode), import_batch_id = VALUES(import_batch_id), metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at), deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL

INSERT INTO rag_import_batch( tenant_id, import_batch_id, user_id, knowledge_base_id, scan_root, file_count, imported_count, skipped_count, vector_store_mode, embedding_mode, embedding_model, started_at, finished_at, latency_ms, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{importBatchId}, #{userId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{scanRoot}, #{fileCount}, #{importedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{vectorStoreMode}, #{embeddingMode}, #{embeddingModel}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{latencyMs}, #{startedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), knowledge_base_id = VALUES(knowledge_base_id), scan_root = VALUES(scan_root), file_count = VALUES(file_count), imported_count = VALUES(imported_count), skipped_count = VALUES(skipped_count), vector_store_mode = VALUES(vector_store_mode), embedding_mode = VALUES(embedding_mode), embedding_model = VALUES(embedding_model), started_at = VALUES(started_at), finished_at = VALUES(finished_at), latency_ms = VALUES(latency_ms)
INSERT INTO rag_import_document(tenant_id, import_batch_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{importBatchId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rag_import_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY started_at DESC
